recentItems.description:
Former Minister Vidadala Rajini house arrest in Chilakaluripet created severe tension in Palnadu district during the ZPTC and MPTC election nominations. Police detained Vidadala Rajini at her residence to prevent any untoward incidents during the local body nomination process.when Vidadala Rajini attempted to leave her house to meet YSRCP candidates and party workers. Women police officers blocked her path, leading to a heated argument and physical scuffle.

Ahead of the corporation elections, mayoral candidates have submitted their affidavits, revealing a mix of significant wealth and financial liabilities. The disclosures highlight candidates owning crores worth of assets, hundreds of acres of land, and gold jewelry. At the same time, several candidates have declared outstanding loans and bank debts. Adding to the intrigue, some candidates also have police cases registered against them. The affidavit details raise interesting questions about who among the candidates is the wealthiest, who carries the most debt, and who leads in the number of criminal cases.

Sidda Sudhakar, the coalition chairperson candidate for Cheemakurthy Municipality in Prakasam district, stated that since the coalition government came to power, both welfare schemes and development activities have been progressing steadily. He noted that road expansion and drinking water facilities have already been made available to residents to a considerable extent. In an interview, Sudhakar expressed his commitment to addressing the major issues facing the town if elected, pledging to work towards resolving key challenges in the coming period.
